elaine_success: I'll run a quick re-engage DM to registrants and send a short poll on what they want covered.

1) 5m intro + goals
2) 20m migration checklist + best practices
3) 25m live lab + infra Q&A
4) 10m next steps / feedback capture

Calendar invite (edit to add co-hosts):
```
https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-workshop-Jun25
```

Also, quick ops note: please use this sign-up form for follow-ups: https://forms.gle/xyz

ops_bot: event updated: co-hosts added: ajay_enable, sam_platform; attendee count updated -> 11 :thumbsup:
